config vpn ipsec phase2-interface
    edit "netops-ipsec"
        set phase1name "netops-ipsec"
        set proposal aes256-sha256
        set dhgrp 14
        set auto-negotiate enable
        set src-subnet 203.0.113.254 255.255.255.255
        set dst-subnet 198.51.100.1 255.255.255.255
    next
end
